title.en: Two Latvians Arrested Inside RAF Molesworth Perimeter, a UK Base Used by the US
title.zh-TW: 2 名拉脫維亞人闖入美軍使用的英國皇家空軍莫爾斯沃思（RAF Molesworth）基地被捕

summary.en: Counterterrorism police arrested two Latvian men inside the perimeter of RAF Molesworth in Cambridgeshire, a British base used by the United States and NATO military intelligence, after they breached the fence around 02:00 BST. The incident renewed scrutiny of security at the installation.
summary.zh-TW: 反恐警察在英國劍橋郡皇家空軍莫爾斯沃思（RAF Molesworth）基地邊界內逮捕兩名拉脫維亞人；該基地供美國與北約軍事情報使用。兩人於英國夏令時間凌晨約 2 點突破圍欄，事件引發外界對基地安全的關注。

body.en:
Two Latvian men were arrested by counterterrorism police inside the perimeter of RAF Molesworth in Cambridgeshire after breaching the fence at about 02:00 BST, according to headlines from British and US outlets. The base is used by the United States, and police said the men were apprehended on suspicion of breaching the perimeter fence of an installation used by NATO and US military intelligence.
What happened
Multiple outlets describe the same core incident: two Latvian nationals were found inside the perimeter of the Cambridgeshire RAF base and detained on suspicion of trespass. The New York Times describes the base as a UK air base used by the US; Sky News and The Guardian identify the men as Latvian nationals or Latvian men; the BBC reports two men arrested on suspicion of trespass at the RAF base in Cambridgeshire. Police said the pair were apprehended at about 02:00 BST.
Why it matters
A perimeter breach at a base used by NATO and US military intelligence raises immediate questions about physical security at a sensitive installation. Counterterrorism police, rather than ordinary officers, making the arrests underscores how seriously the intrusion was treated, and the incident is likely to prompt reviews of how the fence line is monitored.
Sources agree / disagree
Four of the five outlets — the New York Times, Sky News, the BBC, and The Guardian — describe the same RAF Molesworth incident and agree on the essentials: two Latvian men, inside the perimeter, arrested on suspicion of trespass or breaching the fence. The Los Angeles Times item bundled into this card is a different event — a passenger arrested after breaching a gate and stealing a vehicle at John Wayne Airport in California — and should not be read as part of the Molesworth story. Trust label: four outlets consistent on core facts; one unrelated item mixed in by the feed.
Still uncertain
The short feed snippets give no motive, no identities beyond nationality, and no indication of how the men crossed the fence. Click through to the linked outlets for the latest full reporting before quoting details.
body.zh-TW:
兩名拉脫維亞人於英國夏令時間凌晨約 2 點突破圍欄，隨後在劍橋郡英國皇家空軍莫爾斯沃思（RAF Molesworth）基地邊界內被反恐警察逮捕。該基地供美國使用，警方表示兩人涉嫌突破北約與美國軍事情報單位使用的設施圍欄。
發生了什麼事
多家英美媒體報導同一事件：《紐約時報》（The New York Times）稱該基地是美國使用的英國空軍基地；《天空新聞》（Sky News）與《衛報》（The Guardian）確認被捕者為拉脫維亞人；英國廣播公司（BBC）則報導兩名男子在劍橋郡的皇家空軍基地因涉嫌侵入被捕。警方表示，兩人於凌晨約 2 點在邊界內被制伏。
為什麼重要
莫爾斯沃思基地供北約與美國軍事情報使用，圍欄被突破立刻引發對敏感設施實體安全的質疑。由反恐警察而非一般警員執行逮捕，顯示當局對此入侵的重視程度；事件也可能促使基地重新檢視圍欄監控方式。
來源異同
五家來源中有四家——《紐約時報》、《天空新聞》、英國廣播公司與《衛報》——報導的是同一宗莫爾斯沃思事件，核心事實一致：兩名拉脫維亞男子、在基地邊界內、涉嫌侵入或突破圍欄被捕。被同一批次抓取的《洛杉磯時報》（Los Angeles Times）報導則是另一件事：加州約翰韋恩機場（John Wayne Airport）一名乘客闖入閘門並偷車被捕，不應與本案混為一談。信任標籤：四家來源核心事實一致，另混入一則無關報導。
仍不確定
摘要未說明兩人動機、除國籍外的身分，也未交代他們如何越過圍欄。引用細節前，請點進原文連結查閱完整報導。

disagreements.en: No real numeric conflict: the ‘02’ in snippets refers to the time of arrest (02:00 BST), not a different headcount. The substantive issue is that the LA Times item about a vehicle theft at John Wayne Airport is a separate, unrelated event bundled into this card by the feed.
disagreements.zh-TW: 數字並無實質衝突：摘要中的「02」指的是逮捕時間（英國夏令時間凌晨 2 點），而非不同的人數。真正的問題是《洛杉磯時報》關於約翰韋恩機場偷車案的報導是另一宗無關事件，被抓取程式混進了同一張卡片。

summary.en: TechCrunch reports that Netflix’s ‘The Altruists,’ a drama about the FTX scandal, has released a trailer for its fictionalized portrayal of Sam Bankman-Fried, with the show coming to TV screens on November 19. A separate Google AI Blog item covers the winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE, ‘The Gifted.’

body.en:
Two unrelated entertainment items were bundled into this card: TechCrunch’s coverage of the trailer for Netflix’s ‘The Altruists,’ a show about the FTX scandal featuring a fictionalized Sam Bankman-Fried, and the Google AI Blog’s post about the winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE, a short film titled ‘The Gifted.’
What happened
According to TechCrunch, Netflix’s ‘The Altruists’ dramatizes the FTX scandal, and a fictionalized Sam Bankman-Fried is set to appear on television screens on November 19. Separately, the Google AI Blog highlighted the winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE — a piece titled ‘The Gifted’ — with no stated connection to the Netflix series or to FTX.
Why it matters
The Netflix series keeps the FTX collapse in the cultural spotlight, turning one of the most prominent crypto scandals into mainstream drama. The XPRIZE item points in a different direction: an AI-themed film competition recognizing ‘The Gifted,’ suggesting continued interest in storytelling about emerging technology.
Sources agree / disagree
The two items do not corroborate each other — they are separate stories that the feed clustered together. Trust label: two single items from two outlets, no independent corroboration of either; treat details as unconfirmed.
Still uncertain
The snippets give no plot details, cast, or clarity on whether November 19 is a premiere date or a trailer date for ‘The Altruists,’ and no context on the Future Vision XPRIZE beyond its name. Click through to the linked outlets for the full posts.
body.zh-TW:
本卡把兩則無關的娛樂報導湊在一起：科技新聞網站（TechCrunch）報導奈飛影集《利他主義者》（The Altruists）的預告——該劇以 FTX 事件為題材，出現虛構版的薩姆·班克曼-弗里德；以及 Google AI 部落格介紹未來願景 XPRIZE 的獲獎預告片《The Gifted》。
發生了什麼事
據科技新聞網站報導，奈飛的《利他主義者》把 FTX 事件戲劇化，虛構版的薩姆·班克曼-弗里德將於 11 月 19 日登上電視螢幕。另一則來自 Google AI 部落格的報導則介紹未來願景 XPRIZE 的獲獎預告片《The Gifted》，與奈飛影集及 FTX 均無關聯。
為什麼重要
奈飛影集讓 FTX 崩盤事件持續留在大眾文化的聚光燈下，把這起最受矚目的加密貨幣醜聞改編為主流戲劇。XPRIZE 的項目則指向另一個方向：以人工智慧為主題的影片競賽選出《The Gifted》，顯示外界對新興科技敘事的持續興趣。
來源異同
兩則報導並未互相印證——它們是被抓取程式湊在同一張卡片的兩件獨立事件。信任標籤：兩個媒體各一則報導，均無獨立查證，細節視為未確認。
仍不確定
摘要未提供《利他主義者》的劇情、卡司，也沒說明 11 月 19 日是首播日還是預告上線日；未來願景 XPRIZE 除了名稱也無更多背景。請點進原文連結查閱完整內容。

disagreements.en: The two source items describe different events — a Netflix drama about the FTX scandal versus an XPRIZE-winning trailer — bundled together by the feed. There is no factual conflict between them because they are not about the same thing.

title.en: USS Abraham Lincoln Returns to San Diego After Record Deployment Supporting the Iran War
title.zh-TW: 亞伯拉罕·林肯號（USS Abraham Lincoln）航艦返抵聖地牙哥灣：破紀錄部署支援伊朗戰爭

summary.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home to San Diego after a record-setting deployment supporting the Iran war, drawing attention after reports of crew stress, supply shortages, and deteriorating mental health on board. Emotional reunions followed for families who described crying and losing sleep during the long months at sea.
summary.zh-TW: 亞伯拉罕·林肯號（USS Abraham Lincoln）航空母艦在支援伊朗戰爭的破紀錄部署後返抵聖地牙哥。此前報導指出船上出現船員壓力、補給短缺與心理健康惡化，引發關注；家屬形容部署期間以淚洗面、徹夜難眠，返航時場面動容。

body.en:
The USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier has returned home to San Diego Bay after a record-setting deployment supporting the Iran war, ending months at sea that drew public attention over reports of crew stress, supply shortages, and deteriorating mental health among the crew.
What happened
Outlets including NPR, PBS NewsHour, Al Jazeera, and the Los Angeles Times report the carrier’s return to San Diego after what they describe as a record-breaking deployment. Feed descriptions say the extended time at sea drew attention following reports of supply shortages and deteriorating mental health among the crew. Families described an emotional rollercoaster, crying and losing sleep during the deployment, and embraced their loved ones as the ship came home. One report credits its photography to Gregory Bull.
Why it matters
A record-length deployment strains both the crew and the families left behind, and the reported shortages and mental-health toll raise questions about the human cost of sustaining long naval operations. The return also marks the end of a high-profile deployment tied to the Iran war, which had made the ship a symbol of extended American naval commitment in the region.
Sources agree / disagree
Five outlets describe the same homecoming and agree that the deployment set records and strained the crew. The figures differ — 265 uninterrupted days at sea in some items, more than 300 days at sea in others, and a 321-day deployment in the Los Angeles Times headline — but the snippets do not make clear whether these measure the same thing (for example, uninterrupted days at sea versus total deployment length). Trust label: multiple outlets consistent on the story; figures appear to use different metrics — verify before quoting.
Still uncertain
The feed snippets give no official Navy statement, no precise definition of the ‘record,’ and no detail on the supply shortages beyond the families’ accounts. Click through to the linked outlets for the latest full reporting.
body.zh-TW:
亞伯拉罕·林肯號（USS Abraham Lincoln）航空母艦在支援伊朗戰爭的破紀錄部署後返抵聖地牙哥灣，結束了數個月的海上部署；此前船員壓力、補給短缺與心理健康惡化的報導已引發公眾關注。
發生了什麼事
包括美國公共廣播電台（NPR）、公共電視新聞一小時（PBS NewsHour）、半島電視台（Al Jazeera）與《洛杉磯時報》（Los Angeles Times）在內的多家媒體，報導林肯號航空母艦返抵聖地牙哥，形容這是一次破紀錄的部署。摘要指出，漫長的海上部署因補給短缺與船員心理健康惡化的報導而受到關注；家屬形容期間情緒起伏劇烈、以淚洗面、徹夜難眠，軍艦返航時與親人相擁。
為什麼重要
破紀錄的部署長度同時考驗船員與留守家屬的身心，報導中的補給與心理健康問題，讓外界關注維持長期海上行動的人力代價。這次返航也為與伊朗戰爭相關的高調部署畫下句點，該艦已成為美國在該區域長期海軍承諾的象徵。
來源異同
五家媒體報導的是同一場返航，均同意部署創下紀錄且船員承受重壓。數字有差異——有的寫海上不間斷 265 天，有的寫超過 300 天，《洛杉磯時報》標題則是 321 天——但摘要未說明這些數字是否衡量同一區間（例如不間斷海上日數與總部署天數可能不同）。信任標籤：多家來源對事件本身一致；數字疑似採用不同口徑，引用前請查證。
仍不確定
摘要未提供美國海軍的官方說法，也沒定義「紀錄」的具體內涵，補給短缺的細節僅來自家屬說法。請點進原文連結查閱最新完整報導。

disagreements.en: Outlets cite different figures — 265 uninterrupted days at sea, more than 300 days at sea, and a 321-day deployment (LA Times). The snippets do not clarify whether these measure the same period, so they may be different metrics rather than a true conflict.
disagreements.zh-TW: 各家引用數字不同——海上不間斷 265 天、超過 300 天、《洛杉磯時報》的 321 天部署。摘要未說明這些數字是否衡量同一區間，可能是不同口徑而非真正的衝突。

title.en: Michael Douglas Says He Dumped Five Women in One Night to Win Catherine Zeta-Jones
title.zh-TW: 麥克道格拉斯（Michael Douglas）出自傳：為娶凱薩琳麗塔瓊絲（Catherine Zeta-Jones）一夜打 5 通分手電話

summary.en: Michael Douglas, promoting his memoir ‘One Helluva Ride,’ told Britain’s The Times that his wife Catherine Zeta-Jones — 25 years his junior — demanded an exclusive, monogamous relationship early in their romance, so he spent that evening personally calling five other women to end things. The couple married in 2000 and have been together for more than 25 years.
summary.zh-TW: 麥克道格拉斯（Michael Douglas）為宣傳回憶錄《One Helluva Ride》接受英國《泰晤士報》（The Times）專訪，透露小他 25 歲的妻子凱薩琳麗塔瓊絲（Catherine Zeta-Jones）當年交往初期要求一對一的專一關係，他當晚便親自打電話給另外 5 名約會對象分手。兩人 2000 年結婚，攜手超過 25 年。

body.en:
Hollywood veteran Michael Douglas is promoting his memoir ‘One Helluva Ride’ with a candid story about the early days of his romance with Catherine Zeta-Jones: when she demanded a monogamous, one-on-one relationship, he spent that very evening calling five other women to break things off.
What happened
In an interview with Britain’s The Times tied to the memoir’s release, Douglas — known for films including ‘Wall Street’ — recounted that Zeta-Jones, who is 25 years younger, insisted on exclusivity early in their courtship. He told the paper he personally called the other women he had been seeing that same night to end the ambiguous relationships. The couple married in 2000 and have now been together for more than 25 years. Taiwanese outlets including ETtoday, SETN’s entertainment news, and Vogue Taiwan all picked up the interview.
Why it matters
Celebrity memoirs live or die on revealing anecdotes, and this one reframes Douglas’s well-known playboy past as a love story about choosing commitment. It also shows how a single British newspaper interview can ripple across Taiwanese entertainment media within a day.
Sources agree / disagree
All three outlets report the same interview and agree on the essentials — the memoir, The Times interview, the five phone calls, the 2000 marriage. Trust label: consistent retelling of one interview across three outlets; no independent reporting beyond the original.
Still uncertain
The snippets are secondhand retellings of the Times interview, not the full text. Click through to the linked outlets — or the original Times interview — for Douglas’s exact words.
body.zh-TW:
好萊塢資深演員麥克道格拉斯為宣傳回憶錄《One Helluva Ride》，在專訪中坦承當年追求凱薩琳麗塔瓊絲時的往事：當她要求一對一的專一關係，他當晚就打了 5 通電話，與其他約會對象一一分手。
發生了什麼事
配合回憶錄出版，麥克道格拉斯接受英國《泰晤士報》專訪，談起與小他 25 歲的妻子凱薩琳麗塔瓊絲的感情故事。兩人交往初期，妻子要求他維持一對一的專一關係，他當晚便親自打電話給其他約會對象，結束所有曖昧關係。兩人於 2000 年結婚，至今攜手超過 25 年。台灣的 ETtoday 新聞雲、三立新聞網（SETN）娛樂星聞與台灣版《Vogue》都轉載了這段專訪。
為什麼重要

title.en: PTS ‘Independent Correspondent’: Hualien Farmland Recovery, Migrant-Worker Loopholes, and a Flood Anniversary
title.zh-TW: 公視《獨立特派員》：花蓮農地復耕、移工引進漏洞與堰塞湖週年

summary.en: Public Television Service’s ‘Independent Correspondent’ program bundles three Taiwan stories: farmland recovery in Hualien’s Guangfu and Fenglin after a 2025 barrier-lake dam failure buried 773 hectares of fields in mud; loopholes letting employers force migrant workers into ‘AB contracts’; and the first anniversary of the Mataian Creek dam failure that closed a half-century-old hardware store.

body.en:
This card bundles three separate stories from Taiwan’s Public Television Service (PTS) ‘Independent Correspondent’ program: farmland recovery in Hualien after a devastating 2025 barrier-lake dam failure, loopholes in Taiwan’s migrant-worker recruitment system, and the first anniversary of the Mataian Creek dam failure.
What happened
First, Hualien’s Guangfu and Fenglin townships were hit in September 2025 when a barrier lake overflowed and its dam failed, burying 773 hectares of farmland in mud and devastating the local production system. Officials aim to restore 380 hectares of cultivation by the end of 2027, a task testing both administrative resources and grassroots teams balancing anxiety with regulations. Second, an Indonesian worker injured on the job early this year exposed dark corners of cross-border recruitment: a multinational recruited professionals abroad with salaries near NT$50,000, then forced contract swaps on arrival, paid below the legal hourly wage, and assigned white-collar hires to high-risk blue-collar work — exposing review loopholes in Taiwan’s hiring system. Third, one year after the Mataian Creek barrier-lake dam failure devastated Guangfu, the town’s last traditional hardware store — open for more than half a century — closed permanently, while its 77-year-old owner chose to stay, renovate his old house, and start anew with social workers’ and friends’ support.
Why it matters
The three stories share a theme of recovery and systemic gaps: disaster-hit farmland that will take years to reclaim, migrant workers falling through regulatory cracks, and a community still rebuilding a year after the flood. Together they illustrate the long tail of disaster recovery in rural Taiwan.
Sources agree / disagree
All three items come from a single outlet, PTS, so this is one newsroom’s programming lineup rather than independently corroborated reporting. Trust label: single aggregated source — treat as unconfirmed.
Still uncertain
The snippets give no independent verification of the farmland figures, the recruitment case details, or the restoration timeline. Click through to the PTS links for the full reports.
body.zh-TW:
本卡收錄台灣公視《獨立特派員》的三則獨立報導：2025 年堰塞湖潰壩後花蓮農地的復耕之路、台灣移工招募制度的漏洞，以及馬太鞍溪堰塞湖潰壩滿一週年。
發生了什麼事
第一則：2025 年 9 月堰塞湖溢流潰壩，花蓮光復與鳳林 773 公頃農地遭泥流掩埋，生產體系受到毀滅性打擊；官方目標在 2027 年底前完成 380 公頃復耕，考驗行政資源調度，也考驗基層團隊在焦慮與規範間的平衡。第二則：今年初一名因公受傷的印尼籍勞工求助，揭開跨境人力市場的暗角——跨國企業以近 5 萬元高薪在海外招募專業人員，入境後卻強迫換約、以低於法定標準的時薪計酬，甚至讓白領勞工從事高風險藍領工作，凸顯聘僱審查漏洞。第三則：馬太鞍溪堰塞湖潰壩滿一週年，重創花蓮光復鄉；當地最後一間營業逾半世紀的傳統五金行永久歇業，但 77 歲的老闆選擇留在故里重新裝潢老屋，在社工與親友陪伴下展開新生活。
為什麼重要
三則報導共享同一主題：復原與制度缺口——需要多年才能收復的災區農地、掉進法規裂縫的移工，以及洪災一年後仍在重建的社區，共同勾勒出台灣鄉村災後復原的漫長尾巴。
來源異同
三則都來自同一家媒體公視，屬於同一新聞室的節目組合，而非多家獨立查證的報導。信任標籤：僅 1 源聚合／未確認。
仍不確定
摘要未提供農地面積數字的獨立查證、招募個案的細節，也沒有復耕時程的依據。請點進公視連結查閱完整報導。

summary.en: In a case that could affect dozens of similar lawsuits nationwide, the US Supreme Court has heard arguments on whether cities and counties can use state courts to seek damages from fossil fuel companies. body.en:
The US Supreme Court has begun its new nine-month term by hearing arguments in a major climate case out of Boulder County, Colorado, in which fossil fuel companies are seeking to stop cities and counties from suing them in state courts over climate damage.
What happened
According to ESG Dive and The Guardian, the justices heard nearly two hours of arguments on whether local governments can use state courts to seek damages from fossil fuel companies. Suncor Energy and ExxonMobil are attempting to block the lawsuits at the state level, in what The Guardian describes as a bid to strike a fatal blow against litigation holding big oil accountable for the climate crisis. The case could affect dozens of similar lawsuits across the country. After the hearing, it was not yet clear how the court would lean.
Why it matters
The ruling could decide the venue — and the viability — of a wave of climate liability suits. If the companies succeed in pushing the cases out of state courts, dozens of local efforts to recover climate-related costs could stall; if the localities prevail, state courts become a live front in climate accountability.
Sources agree / disagree
Both outlets describe the same hearing and the same stakes with no conflicts in the snippets. Trust label: two outlets consistent on the core facts; details beyond the snippets remain unconfirmed.
Still uncertain
The snippets cut off before any analysis of the justices’ questions, and no ruling or timeline is given. Click through to the linked outlets for full coverage of the arguments.

title.en: White House Blocks Microsoft and Adobe From PERM Green-Card Program Over Alleged Fraud
title.zh-TW: 白宮擋下微軟（Microsoft）與奧多比（Adobe）參與勞工認證計畫（PERM）：涉詐欺疑雲，外籍專業人士工作簽證（H-1B）員工綠卡路徑遭暫停

summary.en: Vice President JD Vance announced Thursday that Microsoft and Adobe are blocked from the PERM program — a path for H-1B workers to obtain green cards — over alleged fraud and abuse. IT outsourcing firms including Cognizant, Infosys, and Tata Consultancy are also caught in the suspension, escalating the administration’s crackdown on immigrant labor.
summary.zh-TW: 副總統范斯（JD Vance）週四宣布，微軟與奧多比（Adobe）因涉嫌詐欺與濫用，被排除在勞工認證計畫（PERM）之外——該計畫是外籍專業人士工作簽證（H-1B）員工取得綠卡的途徑之一。包括高知特（Cognizant）、印孚瑟斯（Infosys）、塔塔諮詢（Tata Consultancy）在內的資訊科技外包公司也被納入暫停範圍，川普政府對移民勞工的打壓再升級。

body.en:
The Trump administration is suspending Microsoft’s, Adobe’s, and several other IT firms’ ability to hire foreign-born workers for US permanent residency, Vice President JD Vance announced Thursday, citing alleged fraud and abuse in the PERM labor certification program.
What happened
According to BBC Business, Tom’s Hardware, and Axios, Microsoft and Adobe are now blocked from the PERM program — one of the possible paths for the firms’ H-1B workers to eventually obtain green card status. Vance said the move was triggered by alleged fraud and abuse. IT outsourcing firms including Cognizant, Infosys, Tata Consultancy, Wipro, HCL, and Capgemini are also caught in the crackdown, and one feed item says the move will affect hundreds of companies tied to the tech giant. The PERM program has for years allowed US tech companies to hire highly skilled workers from abroad.
Why it matters
Blocking household names like Microsoft and Adobe from the green-card pipeline escalates the administration’s crackdown on immigrant labor and could disrupt hiring plans across the tech sector, where H-1B workers have long been a core part of the workforce.
Sources agree / disagree
BBC Business, Tom’s Hardware, and Axios agree on the core story: the PERM suspension, the named companies, and the alleged-fraud rationale. The feed also bundled two unrelated items — a ProPublica investigation finding more than 500 US citizens detained in the immigration crackdown, and an Axios item on Trump calling anyone who says ‘AI’ instead of ‘super intelligence’ ‘the enemy’ — plus listings from the Financial Times and NPR News with no headline detail in the snippets. Those are separate stories, not corroboration of the PERM move. Trust label: three outlets consistent on the PERM story; other bundled items are unrelated — treat separately.
Still uncertain
The snippets give no detail on what the alleged fraud involved, no full list of affected firms, and no timeline for the suspension. Click through to the linked outlets for the full reporting before quoting.
body.zh-TW:
副總統范斯週四宣布，川普政府將暫停微軟、奧多比（Adobe）與其他數家資訊科技公司為外籍出生勞工申請美國永久居留的能力，理由是勞工認證計畫（PERM）涉嫌詐欺與濫用。
發生了什麼事
據 BBC 商業版（BBC Business）、科技媒體（Tom’s Hardware）與新聞網站（Axios）報導，微軟與奧多比現已被排除在勞工認證計畫之外——該計畫是這些公司外籍專業人士工作簽證員工最終取得綠卡身分的途徑之一。范斯表示，此舉是因涉嫌詐欺與濫用而觸發。高知特、印孚瑟斯、塔塔諮詢（Tata Consultancy）、威普羅（Wipro）、HCL 科技（HCL）與凱捷（Capgemini）等資訊科技外包公司也被納入這波打壓；其中一則摘要稱，此舉將影響這家科技巨頭旗下的數百家公司。多年來，勞工認證計畫讓美國科技公司得以聘用海外高技能人才。
為什麼重要
把微軟、奧多比這種家喻戶曉的企業擋在綠卡管道之外，讓川普政府對移民勞工的打壓再升級，也可能打亂科技業的招聘計畫——外籍專業人士工作簽證員工長期是科技業勞動力的重要組成。
來源異同
BBC 商業版、科技媒體與新聞網站對核心事件一致：勞工認證計畫暫停、被點名的公司、以及涉嫌詐欺的理由。同一批次還混入兩則無關報導——非營利新聞室（ProPublica）調查指超過 500 名美國公民在移民打壓中被拘留，以及新聞網站報導川普稱說「AI」而非「超級智慧」的人是「敵人」——另有《金融時報》（Financial Times）與美國公共廣播電台（NPR）的來源列表，但摘要中沒有標題細節。這些是不同事件，不是勞工認證計畫政策的佐證。信任標籤：三家來源對勞工認證計畫事件一致；其他混入項目無關，應分開看待。
仍不確定
摘要未說明涉嫌詐欺的具體內容，也沒有完整的受影響公司名單與暫停時程。引用前請點進原文連結查閱完整報導。

summary.zh-TW: TVBS 8 日公布的台北市長民調顯示，蔣萬安（Chiang Wan-an）以 49% 領先民進黨參選人沈伯洋（Puma Shen）的 41%，未決定選民占 11%，差距拉近至個位數，引發熱議。同時，主持人蔡康永（Kevin Tsai）現身沈伯洋競選總部活動，遭中國網友批評，蔣萬安則回應應尊重台灣。

body.en:
Taipei's mayoral race is heating up on several fronts at once: a new TVBS poll shows incumbent Chiang Wan-an's lead over DPP challenger Puma Shen has narrowed to single digits, while Shen's campaign is generating a separate wave of online chatter — from a viral face-mask story to a cross-strait flare-up over TV host Kevin Tsai's appearance at Shen's campaign office.
What happened
TVBS published its latest Taipei mayoral poll on October 8: Chiang Wan-an stands at 49%, Puma Shen at 41%, with 11% of voters still undecided. Writer Chao Hsiao-hui said Chiang's loyal base appears nearly maxed out and the undecided 11% will be decisive. Shen also gave an interview to veteran media host Chou Yu-kou, whose second half aired today, answering questions about why Chiang should be replaced after just one term. Separately, Shen's skincare routine went viral after he mentioned wearing a face mask for three hours and sleeping in it, saying his forehead looked radiant the next morning — netizens hunted down the product, making "Puma Shen mask" a trending search term, and ETtoday's fashion section even had a doctor explain the correct way to use such masks. In another thread, Kevin Tsai's appearance at the launch of Shen's campaign headquarters drew criticism from Chinese netizens, and a Chinese military social-media account weighed in, saying it would not tolerate "sitting on the fence between the mainland and Taiwan independence." Shen called the backlash regrettable, saying he only wanted to hear different voices; MAC official Liang Wen-chieh said supporting any candidate in Taiwan is easy and free; and Chiang responded that Taiwan deserves respect.
Why it matters
The poll is the first hard data point of this campaign cycle showing the race tightening: with Chiang's support apparently flat and one in nine voters undecided, both camps now face a genuine persuasion battle rather than a coronation. The Kevin Tsai episode shows how quickly entertainment figures get pulled into cross-strait political theater, and the mask story shows how much of this race is being fought on lifestyle and personality terrain as well as policy.
Sources agree / disagree
Fourteen named sources are attached, but this is not one corroborated story — the feed bundles four separate reporting threads: the TVBS poll (Liberty Times, TVBS-affiliated outlets), the Chou Yu-kou interview, the viral face-mask item (ETtoday Fashion), and the Kevin Tsai cross-strait incident (various Taiwan outlets). Within the poll thread, the figures are consistent across snippets: 49% for Chiang, 41% for Shen, 11% undecided — the raw-feed note about figures "differing" ("41 vs 4") appears to be garbled aggregation text, not a real conflict. Trust label: multi-source but fragmented across separate threads — treat each thread's claims separately; single aggregated heat feed, unconfirmed.
Still uncertain
The snippets give no poll methodology, sample size, or margin of error, and quote only truncated reactions. The details of the Chinese military account's statement and the exact remarks by Chiang, Shen, and Liang are available only in abbreviated feed text. Click through to the linked outlets before quoting any figure or quote.
body.zh-TW:
台北市長選戰同時在多條戰線升溫：TVBS 最新民調顯示現任市長蔣萬安對民進黨參選人沈伯洋的領先已縮小到個位數；沈伯洋陣營也接連創造話題——從爆紅的面膜到主持人蔡康永現身競總引發的兩岸口水戰。
發生了什麼事
TVBS 8 日公布最新台北市長民調：蔣萬安（Chiang Wan-an）49%、沈伯洋（Puma Shen）41%，未決定選民占 11%。作家趙曉慧表示，蔣萬安的死忠基本盤差不多榨乾了，剩下的 11% 未決定選民將是關鍵。沈伯洋另接受資深媒體人周玉蔻專訪，下集於今日播出，回應「為何要換掉只做一任的蔣萬安」等提問。此外，沈伯洋的保養日常意外爆紅：他提到一款要敷 3 小時的面膜，自己通常敷完直接睡覺，隔天起床額頭特別亮；網友瘋找同款，「沈伯洋面膜」成為熱搜關鍵字，壹蘋時尚（ETtoday 時尚）還請醫師說明正確敷法。另一條支線是蔡康永（Kevin Tsai）現身沈伯洋競選總部成立活動，遭中國網友出征，中國軍方帳號也首度發聲，稱「不容在大陸與台獨之間騎牆搖擺」。沈伯洋嘆可惜，說只是想聽不同聲音；陸委會副主委梁文傑聲援，指在台灣支持哪個候選人都很輕鬆；蔣萬安則回應應尊重台灣。
為什麼重要
這是本屆選戰第一個顯示選情拉近的硬數據：蔣萬安支持度似已停滯，近一成選民未定，雙方進入真正的說服戰，而非一面倒的保衛戰。蔡康永事件顯示娛樂人物多快會被捲入兩岸政治劇場；面膜話題則顯示這場選戰除了政策，也在生活風格與個人魅力上開打。
來源異同
名單上有 14 個具名來源，但這不是一篇被交叉查證的單一報導——熱榜把四條不同支線綁在一起：TVBS 民調（自由時報等）、周玉蔻專訪、面膜爆紅（壹蘋時尚）、蔡康永兩岸爭議（多家台媒）。在民調支線內，數字各摘要一致：蔣萬安 49%、沈伯洋 41%、未定 11%；原始摘要裡「41 比 4」之類的分歧註記疑似聚合文字錯亂，並非真實衝突。信任標籤：多源但碎片化——各支線分開看待；單一熱榜聚合，未確認。
仍不確定
摘要未提供民調方法學、樣本數或誤差範圍，引用的評論也都是截斷片段。中國軍方帳號聲明的完整內容，以及蔣萬安、沈伯洋、梁文傑發言的確切用字，都只見於簡短摘要。引用任何數字或引言前，請點進原文連結查閱完整報導。

The raw feed's "41 vs 4" disagreement note appears to be garbled aggregation text. The actual honesty issue is structural — this cluster bundles four separate reporting threads (poll, interview, face-mask item, Kevin Tsai incident), not one corroborated story.

Amazon's fall sale is back: Prime Big Deal Days is running its biggest markdowns of the season on beauty, with Allure and Refinery29 editors rounding up the discounts they would actually buy — and the clock nearly out.

Charlotte Tilbury, Estee Lauder, Sulwhasoo and Lancome are among the luxury beauty brands discounted for Prime Big Deal Days. Prime Day has become one of the year's biggest retail moments, and beauty is one of the categories where brand-name products rarely go this deep on discount. body.en:
Apple is reportedly about to end a long-standing holdout: its first touchscreen MacBook could arrive before the month is out, according to Bloomberg reporting picked up by The Verge and Engadget.
What happened
Bloomberg reports that Apple will introduce a new MacBook Pro with a touchscreen display and an updated iPad Mini "on or around" October 27. If the timing holds, the launch would come just two weeks after the October 13 event Apple announced — an event rumored to focus on smart-home products. Bloomberg adds that the late-October event will feature an "online video presentation" and an "in-person component," per the feed snippets. The Verge framed it as Apple's first touchscreen MacBook debuting in about three weeks; Engadget's version of the story carries the same date and product lineup.
Why it matters
A touchscreen Mac would be a major strategic reversal: Apple has long argued that touch belongs on the iPad, not the Mac, while Windows rivals have offered touchscreens for years. If Bloomberg's report is right, it signals Apple is finally willing to blur the line between its two product families — and a refreshed iPad Mini would sweeten an unusually packed October.
Sources agree / disagree
Two named outlets — The Verge and Engadget — are reporting the same Bloomberg-sourced rumor with matching dates ("on or around" October 27) and the same two products, with no numeric or name conflicts in the snippets. This is one rumor carried by two outlets, not two independent confirmations. Trust label: 2 sources consistent, single underlying source (Bloomberg) — treat as rumor, not confirmation.
Still uncertain
Everything here is reported, not announced: Apple has confirmed nothing, and the snippets are truncated before detailing what the "in-person component" entails or which smart-home products the October 13 event will cover. Wait for Apple's official word before treating dates or specs as final.

body.en:
Two unrelated stories were bundled into one feed cluster: a set of industry-technical pieces on process control for hybrid bonding and advanced packaging, plus a PBS report on a US Army investigation into the DC midair collision. They share no topic, outlet, or facts.
What happened
Semiconductor Engineering ran a series of articles on process control for hybrid bonding and advanced packaging. Their argument: in advanced packaging, value accumulates layer by layer, component by component, and process step by process step — by the time chiplets, high-bandwidth memory stacks, or hybrid-bonded devices reach assembly, manufacturers have already invested substantial material and processing resources, so an undetected defect at that stage can jeopardize the whole larger assembly. The pieces note that the explosive growth of heterogeneous integration — from 2.5D interposers and CoWoS to hybrid bonding and 3D stacking — is redefining what it means to "ramp a process," and that advanced packaging shows yield sensitivities and defect mechanisms fundamentally different from front-end logic, while the industry still lacks purpose-built metrology and characterization. They add that AI, high-performance computing, advanced smartphones, automotive electronics, and next-generation networking increasingly depend on advanced packaging for bandwidth, power efficiency, and functionality.
Why it matters
The technical pieces describe an industry inflection point: packaging innovation is becoming as important as transistor scaling for delivering AI and HPC performance. Catching defects early is framed not as quality theater but as economics — the later a flaw is found, the more expensive it is. (No significance can be drawn from the second item's pairing here; it is a separate news event.)
Sources agree / disagree

A Tennessee death-row case and an Atlantic hurricane were bundled into one feed cluster. The death-penalty story is the substantive thread: multiple outlets report on Christa Pike's condition after the state failed to execute her.
What happened
Christa Pike has begun walking and eating again at a hospital a week after surviving Tennessee's attempt to execute her with lethal drugs, her attorneys said Thursday. One report says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections. A judge has ordered that evidence from Pike's failed execution be preserved. Why it matters
A failed execution is an extraordinary event with legal and human stakes: preserved evidence will matter for the inevitable court battles over what went wrong, and the ProPublica angle frames Pike's case as part of a pattern rather than a one-off. (The hurricane thread is a separate weather emergency for Gulf Coast residents and should be read on its own.)

There is no real numeric or name conflict — the raw feed's "2 vs 14" figure note is garbled aggregation text. body.en:
OpenAI's revenue numbers are moving markets: the AI lab told investors it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September — a figure that came in well below earlier reports — and AI-linked stocks dropped on the news.
What happened
OpenAI told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September, CNBC confirmed. The figure fell short of expectations: it had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, and TechCrunch's headline puts the gap at about $20 billion less than previously projected. Analysts quoted in the coverage say the shortfall reflects differences in how the figure is reported, not weakness in AI demand. The market reaction was swift: CNBC reports Nvidia, Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sank on the revenue report, while MarketWatch reports Micron, Nvidia and AI chip stocks fell as the report caused what it calls "undue concern." Bloomberg News also covered the story on its Daybreak Asia podcast.
Why it matters
OpenAI's revenue trajectory is the market's proxy for the entire AI trade: when its numbers disappoint, the selloff spreads to chipmakers, cloud providers, and the broader AI supply chain within hours. The analyst pushback — that this is a reporting-methodology quirk, not demand weakness — is the key question investors must resolve before deciding whether the dip is a buying opportunity or a warning.
Sources agree / disagree
Four named outlets — CNBC, MarketWatch, TechCrunch, and Bloomberg News — are covering the same core facts: ~$50B annualized revenue at end of September, previously reported ~$70B, AI stocks down. There is no real conflict: the raw feed's "50 vs 20" figure note misreads the story — $20 billion is the size of the shortfall versus $70 billion, not an alternative revenue figure. Trust label: 4 sources consistent on the core facts — but all are reporting the same investor-disclosure story, and the $50B figure itself is unaudited and reported second-hand.

body.en:
Taiwanese outlets are reporting an extraordinary claim about US military justice: the gunman in the Fort Hood shooting — which killed 13 and wounded 32 — is to be executed by firing squad, and the Pentagon has confirmed the execution will be livestreamed in full.
What happened
According to the Taiwan outlets, the US military will execute the Fort Hood gunman, and Pentagon officials confirmed the execution will be livestreamed in full. Why it matters
If confirmed, a publicly livestreamed military execution — described as the first since World War II — would be a historic and highly controversial event, raising questions about transparency, deterrence, and the treatment of victims' families. The story is currently circulating as Taiwan-media reporting citing Pentagon confirmation; its significance depends entirely on that confirmation being real.
Sources agree / disagree
Three named sources — today.line.me (carrying FTV News), ctwant, and ltn.com.tw — carry closely related headlines with the same core claims: execution by firing squad, full livestream, Pentagon confirmation. There is no real numeric conflict: the raw feed's "13 vs 12" note misreads the headlines — 13 is the death toll of the original shooting, while "12/3" is the reported execution date. Trust label: 3 named sources consistent, but all are second-hand Taiwan-media items via a single heat feed — the Pentagon confirmation claim is unverified; treat as unconfirmed.
Still uncertain
Only headlines and one-line summaries are available; no statement from the Pentagon itself, no named Pentagon official, and no independent US-media confirmation appear in the snippets. The year of the December 3 date is not stated. Do not treat the livestream claim as confirmed without reading the linked outlets and checking for primary-source confirmation.
body.zh-TW:
台媒正在報導一則關於美軍司法的驚人消息：釀成 13 死 32 傷的胡德堡槍擊案凶嫌將遭槍決，且美國防部已證實將全程直播槍決過程。
發生了什麼事
根據台媒報導，美軍將槍決胡德堡槍擊案凶嫌，美國防部官員證實將全程直播。CTWANT 的標題提到原案造成 13 死 32 傷；另有一則標題稱這是美軍二戰後首度槍決，執行日期為 12/3。具名來源為民視新聞網（經 LINE TODAY 刊登）、CTWANT，以及 ltn.com.tw（自由時報），皆經由 Google 新聞熱榜聚合。
為什麼重要
若屬實，一場公開直播的軍事槍決——被稱為二戰後首度——將是歷史性且高度爭議的事件，牽涉透明度、嚇阻效果與罹難者家屬感受等問題。但目前這只是台媒引述「國防部證實」的報導，其重要性完全取決於該證實是否為真。
來源異同
三個具名來源——today.line.me（刊登民視新聞網）、ctwant、ltn.com.tw——標題高度相關，核心說法一致：槍決、全程直播、國防部證實。沒有真實數字衝突：原始摘要「13 比 12」的註記誤讀了標題——13 是原案死亡人數，12/3 是報導中的執行日期。信任標籤：3 個具名來源說法一致，但都是經單一熱榜聚合的二手台媒報導——「國防部證實」的說法未經核實，視為未確認。
仍不確定
目前只有標題與一句話摘要；摘要中沒有國防部本身的聲明、沒有具名官員，也沒有美國本土媒體的獨立證實。12/3 的年份也未說明。在查閱原文連結並找到第一手證實之前，請勿把直播說法當成定案。
